Population.evidence_source: Of those who admitted having attempted suicide at some time, about half had made only one attempt (around a quarter of the sample). In this group, we also included two individuals who had had close encounters with suicide without having made an actual attempt on their life. One man had climbed onto the rail of a high bridge and was eventually coaxed down by a passer-by. Another, Simon, had carried a gun around for a year, contemplating suicide.
